jq.name: the workflow plugin is a job plugin that declares the run_script import and requires script
jq.expr: plugin | .name == "workflow" and .job == true and .host_imports == ["run_script"] and (.script_runtime == null) and (.input_schema.required | index("script") != null) and .instructions == "plugins/workflow/TOOL.md" and .limits.wall_clock_secs <= 900

jq.name: the caller template names only the read-only worker and ships dynamic as check (a pack may not ship run)
the worker is read-only with no network and no session history
the TOOL.md example asks text only of completed children (the host refuses child_output for a failed slot)
jq.expr: .assets["plugins/workflow/TOOL.md"] | contains("const ok = slots.filter(completed);") and contains("read(ok)") and (contains("read(slots)") | not)
